lines.en: ’Twas the month before Christmas and weeks after ween — where the hallows craft gallows and hang old routines.
How curious, furious at all that I see. To think that one night could rewrite this for me.
Will the future be sutured to match how he used her? Where it seems that the seams come unraveled (or looser).
’Twas whatever, whenever. I don’t care. Why bother? This has nothing to do with a father or daughter.
But it DOES have something to do with some other stuff that needs to blah blah blah sex fuck cum shit fuck dick fuck. Makoto.
: What are you doing here? I thought you’d be with your friends.
: I needed a break for a minute. They’re making me feel crazy.
: I see. Well, have you stopped to consider for a second that you may actually just be crazy?
: Yeah, that’s kind of what this break is. How are things in here? Are you having fun?
: Uhh...I suppose.
: Am I bothering you? Should I leave? I don’t normally come to parties my daughter is at. How do I mom in this scenario?
: You’re not bothering me, per se. I’m clearly not doing anything since Miku is relaxing in the quiet room.
: I just don’t really get why you’re here. Or why being crazy is suddenly an issue to you at all when you spend at least ten hours a day reorganizing rubber penises.
: Heh. You said penis.
: Okay, listen. Me and the girls had a-
: The girls and I.
: The girls and I had a talk about Christmalloween costumes and how I think they’re just...you know...
: Potentially being abused by some girls your age who might not understand the potential ramifications or consequences of expressing sexual freedom before getting out of high school.
: How long did it take you to memorize the wording of that?
: Like five minutes. I don’t think I’ve ever used “ramification” in a sentence before.
: Heh. Ram-ification. Like sex.
: The dichotomy of your tone right now is taking me for quite the ride.
: Okay, but-
: And before you reach for some other euphemism about being taken for a ride or whatever you’re in the process of saying, know that you will be falling directly into my trap.
: Makoto, you know what I’m saying, right? That some of the costumes you girls normally wear for these parties, like...
: Well, they’re wearing them specifically so Sensei will look at them, right?
: Some of them, sure. Is that really something you should be saying when you’re dressed like that, though?
: I’m an adult. It’s fine if people want to ramify me. You girls are different, though. You girls are only-
: Doing what we want to do and not succumbing to the archaic ideology that we should be dressing modestly in order to avoid the male gaze. What happened to you?
: What do you mean what happened to me? Just look around at-
: Oh. I guess it’s not actually that bad this year.
: What I meant is that this isn’t something I’d expect you to complain about. And I’m curious as to why you are now going out of your way to approach me about it for support.
: Can a mother not look out for other girls now? I just don’t want any of you getting sucked into something you don’t fully understand yet.
: Like, freedom or not, willingly taking your clothes off and then parading your body in front of an older guy is going to send some signals.
: I’m sorry, do I look unclothed right now? Why are you talking to me about this?
: I’m practically the queen of modesty among my peers. Which is quite odd considering I work in a sex shop.
: I’m just worried. That’s all. You’re still a teenager and-
: And, with all due respect, I’m smarter and more mature than you. So maybe I should be the one lecturing you about sexual safety?
: What? Makoto? I’m just-
: I apologize if that sounded harsh or rude. I just think you’re putting a little too much stake on a number and not enough on a person’s character. That’s all.
: Plenty of girls start having sex at my age. It’s completely normal. You should understand firsthand the battlefield that is puberty as you went through it yourself.
: I did. But the context matters here.
: Most of you girls are specifically trying to capture Sensei’s attention. And that’s bad for both you and him. I could care less if it was happening with-
: Couldn’t care less.
: What?...
: You couldn’t care less. Saying you could care less implies that you don’t feel all that strongly one way or the other.
: And again, with all due respect, if you can’t understand even that much, you probably shouldn’t be lecturing people about the nuances of sex. Just saying.
: Anything else?
: Does talking down to people who aren’t as smart as you make you feel superior, Makoto?
: Are you not doing the same thing right now? Because it sure sounds like you’re telling me that you know what’s better for me than I do.

: And to that I say — was it also necessary to have so much audible group sex down the hall from me when I was even younger? Because I’d love to hear how that was a positive influence on my sexual growth.
: So you think I’m crazy too then?...
: I don’t think anyone thinks you’re crazy. I think that’s just how you interpreted a disagreement on what, to you, seems like black and white ethics.
: But there’s far more nuance to this than you understand, Mom.
: And I’m going to keep being myself at the risk of becoming like you if I don’t.
: Okay...
: Maybe I don’t know what I’m talking about then...
: Yumi! Hi. Would it be weird if I gave you a present?
: Yes.
: Why?
: Uhh...because we’ve talked like one time? And because the last time you handed me something, I opened it and found out my mom had cancer.
: It ain’t a death certificate in there this time, is it? Can it wait until the party’s over?
: It’s just a birthday present. I wouldn’t attach a candy cane to a death certificate. That’s so totally tone-deaf.
: Ain’t it the middle of November? My birthday’s the 31st of last month on a holiday you guys don’t believe in anymore.
: Really? Then your records at school are wrong because I might have looked into them to try and figure out the date.
: That’s an invasion of privacy if I’ve ever fuckin’ heard one.
: Yes. But I also know your three sizes now, so it’s possible I used that information to buy you a fancy bra and shoved it inside this package. Don’t you want to open it and find out?
: Not really. But I’m startin’ to think that openin’ it might be the only way to get you to leave me alone, so...
: Great. Well, fair warning, it’s not a bra. I’m sorry if I got your hopes up.
: Not a thing I’d be excited to receive anyway...
: But, uhh...thanks, I-
: Great! Cool! So anyway, now that you’ve accepted my gift, how’s your mom?
: You ain’t even gonna let me open it before flashin’ me your ulterior motive?
: I’ve accidentally flashed so many people today that I’m just going to write a blanket apology letter and read it in school next week. Also, it’s just a shirt in there. So, yeah. Yuki?
: You know, you could’ve just asked me about her without givin’ me shit. I don’t need a bribe.
: It helps though, yeah?
: Yeah, kinda. What do you want to know?
: Well, to start, is she feeling any better? Because she looks better. She came by to pick up some stuff from her apartment a few weeks ago and I almost didn’t recognize her at first.
: Also, totally random question, but could you maybe estimate the percentage of gay that she is? Rounding up, please.
: She has fuckin’ cancer now and you’re tryin’ to flirt with her? Through her daughter?
: You probably see this as crazy, but I see my persistence as a plus. I’m goal-oriented, loyal, and I can do things with my tongue that normal humans could never even fathom.
: You don’t have to tell her that part, though. I’d prefer to show her on my own once she stops ignoring me and lets me convert her.
: Yeah, good luck with that. She’s got some other lady draggin’ her around like a pet now. Figure if anyone’s gonna convert my mom, it’ll be her.
: Sorry. Could you repeat that? Just without all that stuff about some other woman being in the picture now so I can wipe it from my memory and pretend it never happened?
: The fuck you even interested in that piece of shit for? Yuki ain’t good for nothin’. All she does is fuckin’ lie and talk shit.
: Like, if you need a bodyguard, there are probably better options now and-
: Yumi, I’ll give it to you straight. I am chronically alone. I have a pillow in my bedroom I use specifically for crying into.
: Your mom is hot. We are close in age. She is my type. And also I can fix her.
: Now, tell me who I am competing against so I can look them up online and then probably cry when I realize they’re younger and prettier than me.
: Just fuckin’ call her. You have her number, don’t you?
: Yes! But like I said, she keeps ignoring me! It’s almost like she doesn’t want to talk or something! I don’t get it! There’s no way she’s a 0%%’er! All girls are at least a little gay!
: I ain’t. Do I just not exist or somethin’?
: Oh God! Is it genetic?! Is that curable too?! See if the hospital will-
: Anyway! Thanks for the shirt. I am now walking away forever. Goodbye and do not talk to me.
: Ahh! It’s like you don’t want to talk either now! What is going on?!
: So, have you really just been wandering around looking for my dad all night?
: Are you asking me as a friend, co-worker, rival, daughter, or incest demon?
: I guess all of the above? But don’t let me being a rival prevent you from telling me the truth. I’ve more or less accepted that everyone is going to fuck my dad by now.
: Then yes, Ami. I have been wandering around looking for him ever since leaving the quiet room. But alas. The only room that is truly quiet is my vagina.
: What?
: I don’t know, okay?! I keep wearing costumes designed to appeal to millenials, but your dad is weird and doesn’t like the same things the rest of them do! And also, he is gone! Quiet vagina!
: Is it...supposed to make noise?
: It’s a metaphor! I think! I don’t know what a metaphor is! Take me to your dad and we can find out!
: I don’t know where he is either, okay? He left with Ayane a few hours ago and I haven’t seen him since. Plus, I’m pretty sure Maya had him rented out after her, so...
: Damn it. There some kind of sign-up sheet I just haven’t been informed of or something? What’s a girl gotta do to get a little extra credit around here?
: So you, like...really like him now, huh?
: That’s what I do, Ami. When I fall, I fall hard. And now that we’ve kissed, I-
: Wait, you kissed?
: Oh no. Are you gonna kill me now?
: No, I just didn’t know.
: How was it? What else happened? What’d he do next?
: He, uhh...
: Did he finger you? Did you suck him off? Tell me. In detail. Please.
: He kinda just...
: Left.
: What? That’s it? He just left?
: Yes! Which is like super annoying because I was super horny that night and would have let him do all sorts of pervy, freaky things to me without even asking my parents first!
: It’s just so unfair!
: And now Maya has him?! I bet she’s one of the freakiest, perviest girls around! And I have no proof of that, but I can guarantee you it’s true!
: Oh, it is. She’s probably either choking him or choking on him as we speak.
: Ugh! Why can’t it be me?
: I’m friggin’ desperate at this point, Ami. I’d probably have an orgasm from somebody just poking my elbow.
: Hey. Look over there.
: Why? It better be Sensei or I’ll-
: Or what? What sort of consequence could an adorable thing like you possibly have in store for me?
: Are you having an impulsive gay moment again? How did we break free last time? I don’t remember.
: Who says we have to break free at all, Uta? You’re desperate, aren’t you?
: And Sensei might not be here to take care of you, but I am.
: Nobody needs to know. Plus, don’t you think it might be fun to spite him while he’s off playing with Maya instead of us?...
: They could just be...playing checkers...
: Checkers? Really?
: Or the...1999 PC Classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon...
: Uta, do you have any idea what happens in my house? Any idea how many girls I’ve listened to my dad have his way with while I had to sit there and play with myself?
: All night sometimes...moaning...and panting...the headboard slamming up against the wall as he uses them like toys...
: It gets me so jealous...having to hear that so often...
: So I don’t think anyone would hold it against us if we were just...so desperate and...so alone that we...maybe...
: Found a little comfort in...each other?...
: I mean...
: How sure are you that...
: That we could keep it a secret?...
: Uta. I’m messing with you.
: What?! No you’re not! You can’t have two yuri scenes with me and blueball me in both! Not when I’m this vulnerable and raring to go!
: Were you actually going to go along with it? I thought you’d know I was joking.
: You seemed so serious! Is everyone in your family skilled in the art of seduction or what?!
: You want to kiss at least? We’re not playing spin the bottle as a class this year, but that doesn’t mean you and me can’t play a game of our own.
: F...Fine, but...
: We should go somewhere more private and-
: PFFFTHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! YOU FELL FOR IT AGAIN! WHY ARE YOU SO EASY?!
: LEAVE ME ALONE! I’VE BEEN ASKING MYSELF THAT SAME QUESTION FOR YEARS!
